limitations: One timing sample, not a benchmark distribution.
Extrapolation excludes physics, I/O and scheduling overhead.
No in-process CPU profile; measured cost and source call graph explain a bottleneck, not exact elapsed-run attribution.
proposed_fix: Reference the selected saved plan revision in per-tick reservation snapshots; preserve full current-candidate hashing and fresh physical admission at selection, approval consumption and dispatch.
source_boundary: saved prediction artifacts and frozen implementation; no simulator or provider invocation

source_locations.basis: Each compact trial retains all orbital_coast samples.
One candidate contains four compact trials plus bound source and deployment identities.
Each approval_snapshot calls reservation twice; each reservation hashes the full selected candidate.
Each pre-dispatch step publishes two snapshots.
